info.title: LintMark
info.description: Markdown linting and formatting tool for DEMA Consulting

options.name: --check
options.description: Report problems without writing any file (default)

options.name: --fix
options.description:
Rewrite files into canonical form,
then report the problems that remain (not with --check or --diff)

options.name: --diff
options.description: Print a unified diff of what --fix would change; writes no file

options.name: --config
options.description: Use this configuration file instead of discovering .lintmark.yaml

options.name: --no-config
options.description: Ignore .lintmark.yaml and .editorconfig; use the built-in defaults

options.name: --enable
options.description:
Force rules on (comma-separated ids or MDxxx numbers; repeatable);
wins over the configuration

options.name: --results
options.description: Write validation results to file (.trx or .xml)

options.name: --depth
options.description: Set heading depth for markdown output (default: 1)
